title: Lusin's theorem (Simon 1.17)
statement: For every topological space X in which every closed set is a countable intersection of open sets, every Borel regular outer measure μ on X, every μ-measurable A ⊆ X with μ(A) < ∞, every f : A → ℝ measurable for the trace on A of the σ-algebra of μ-measurable sets, and every real ε > 0, there is a closed C ⊆ X with C ⊆ A, μ(A ∖ C) < ε, and f restricted to C continuous.
